# AI Voice Agents for Electricians
> Antek Automation builds AI voice agents for UK electricians who take emergency work, from £497 setup, set up by Andy Norman, sorting urgent call-outs from routine jobs.

## About Antek Automation
- Trading name: Antek Automation (sole trader)

## What this site covers
- Emergency and out-of-hours call handling for electricians, sorted into wake me now, tell me in the morning, and not for us
- Rules on what counts as urgent are set by the electrician
- Callers reporting burning smells, sparking or danger are told to leave the property and call 999, or the network operator on 105 for a power cut
- Setup from £497 and from £97 a month

## Key facts
- Made for: Emergency and out-of-hours call-outs
- Sorts calls into: Wake me, tell me in the morning, not for us
- You set: What counts as urgent
- Danger line: Callers told to leave and ring 999
